name: Homes Under the Hammer
description: Homes Under the Hammer is a British renovation and auction series that originally screened on BBC One as part of the BBC's morning television schedule, the series has been running since 2003. Its main presenters are Lucy Alexander and Martin Roberts, although in series three Marc Woodward and Jasmine Birtles alternated presenting duties with Alexander and Roberts. The series is the BBC's most successful show in the 10:00am slot, regularly attaining a 30% market share for new episodes.

videos.overview: An old forge cottage in Upton near Newark, a two-bed house in Selhurst, London, and a very sad-looking house in Butt Lane, Staffordshire, all go under the hammer.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: A cottage in Cumbria, a trio of buildings in Stansted Mountfitchet in Essex and a house with outbuildings in North Yorkshire all go under the hammer.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: A split-level flat with bags of potential in North Shields and a couple of semis in West Bromwich and Crewe are all sold under the hammer. They are bought by seasoned developers and one novice. So who will make the most money from their investments?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Martin, Dion and Martel travel across the country to talk to the new owners of three auction property buys. A two bedroom terrace in Norwich, a four bed semi in Wolverhampton and a terrace in Ilford in East London are the latest development projects. All the new owners have plans to make improvements, but will any of them manage to make a profit?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: A new baby, a wedding and brothers in law working together for the first time make today's show a real family affair. Their projects are in Brierley Hill in the West Midlands, Aveley in Essex and Llansamlet near Swansea. Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell follow progress on the large semi detached houses and small studio flat.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A three-bed town house in Staleybridge in Cheshire, a maisonette in Barnet in Hertfordshire and an end terrace in West Bromwich in the West Midlands complete with a potential building plot are all sold under the hammer. Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell talk to the new owners to hear their plans, which will take between a few weeks and several years to come together.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A period property in Copley in County Durham is sold at auction, as are terraces in Treherbert in Wales and Swinton in Yorkshire. Two are bought by people who want to turn them into their homes, while another sees profit potential in doing it up and selling it on. Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell follow their progress.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The new owner of a semi in Faversham in Kent is faced with security issues, while in Liverpool someone buys a piece of land knowing it's unlikely it can be built on. But perhaps the biggest challenge is with a flat in a block in Walworth in London, which is bought despite the fact that it might be demolished. Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell follow the auction-buy developments.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: A run-down Victorian terrace in Walthamstow, a piece of land in Bury in Greater Manchester and a Victorian pub in the historic mining town of Blaenau Ffestiniog in Wales are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Dion and Martel talk to the new owners and hear what they hope to achieve with their auction buys. But as the months and years pass, it is clear that not everything goes to plan.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell follow progress on projects stretching just a few months to six years, as three sets of families take on ambitious plans to sort out property in Congleton in Cheshire, Coalburn in Lanarkshire and Kings Lynn in Norfolk.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview:
Martel Maxwell meets a developer who plans to add value to a studio flat in Handley, while there is an update on a period house in Berkhamsted which Lucy first saw in 2015, and Martin Roberts chats to a mum and her son who buy two flats in a Victorian house in Bootle in Merseyside.

They all want to make money from their auction investments, and for some the projects run smoothly, while one set of developers have to jump over lots of hurdles to get their project finished.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: A terraced house in Wigton in Cumbria, a studio flat in Purley in Surrey and a former working men's club, with planning permission, in Cannock in Staffordshire are sold under the hammer. The team take a look and hear plans from the new owners.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: A huge office space above a bank in Tring in Hertfordshire, a terraced house in Ashton-under-Lyne in Lancashire and a semi in Ambergate in Derby are sold under the hammer. The team check out the auction buys and talk to the new owners, who hope to create lovely new homes while making a profit.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Dion visits a two-bed terrace in Salford, Martel goes to Derbyshire to look at a three-bed semi, and Martin is in south London, where a one-bedroom flat is the order of the day. The team want to know whether the renovations of these auction properties have gone to plan or if the owners have bitten off more than they can chew.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Martin is on the Dorset coast finding out whether a six-year journey will result in the perfect home for a young couple. Martel is in Greater Manchester where a mid-terrace is in need of some TLC, and Dion is in Ellesmere Port, where a first-time renovator is tackling a three-bed semi.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Martel Maxwell visits a property in Birmingham with some mesmerising wallpaper and a south Wales house that has her dancing with joy, while Dion Dublin is in Liverpool to see a place that has him a bit confused.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Martin Roberts visits a property in Shropshire, Martel Maxwell is in Cumbria and Dion Dublin in Derby. Will the new owners of these auction properties prosper, or will the renovations prove too hard to handle?

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: A trio of properties all bought without viewing ahead of the auction are all sold under the hammer. Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell talk to the new owners in West Bromwich, Leeds and Croydon to discover if any of them regret their buys.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Martel Maxwell is in Cumbria visiting a former chip shop, Martin Roberts is in London looking at a one-bedroom flat, and Dion Dublin comes across a plot of land in Greater Manchester. This varied trio of auction lots are all ripe for reinvention, but what will they become?

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Lucy Alexander visits a maisonette over three floors in Crystal Palace, London. Martel Maxwell is in Leeds where a troublesome tree is causing issues at a three-bed semi, and Dion Dublin is in Doncaster at a characterful cottage in a bad state of repair.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Dion Dublin visits a bungalow in Cheshire being renovated by a couple as their new home, and an old chapel in Dudley ripe for development into flats. Martel Maxwell is in West Yorkshire at an end of terrace, where the new owners have grand plans for a child-friendly development.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Martin Roberts revisits a Derbyshire development project, overseen by a husband and wife team, which he first came across in 2016. Plus Dion Dublin gets a driving test at a Bootle property and Martel Maxwell is near Preston at a detached property with a strange layout.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Martin Roberts is in Croydon, at a basement flat bought by two brothers and Martel Maxwell visits a colourful terrace in Cumbria. Dion Dublin is in Greater Manchester, where a first-time developer has taken on a real challenge.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Martel Maxwell visits properties in Preston and Liverpool in need of renovation. Dion Dublin is in Nottingham to meet a couple with differing views on how their project should go.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Dion Dublin visits a property in Manchester and has some motorised fun with a toy car at a house in Liverpool. Plus the team revisit a London project Lucy Alexander first saw three years previously. It didn't have a roof back then, but it's been worth waiting for the finish.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Martin Roberts is by the seaside in Norfolk, Martel Maxwell encounters a house with no stairs in Lancashire, and Dion Dublin is in Staffordshire at a two-up-two-down with a carpeted bath.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Dion Dublin meets an impressive young developer in Merseyside, Martin Roberts is in Stoke, where a couple have a long-term plan for their renovation, and Martel Maxwell is in Leeds with a first-time developer.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Dion Dublin is in Dover at a property right by the famous white cliffs, Martin Roberts is in the leafy London suburbs of Wood Green, and Martel Maxwell visits a project in Cumbria.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: The programme revisits an interesting site in Middlesex that Lucy Alexander first looked at in 2016. Martel Maxwell is in Worcester at a three-bed house, and Dion Dublin sees a tiny basement flat in Liverpool.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Martin Roberts looks around a flat in Pimlico, London, and Martel Maxwell is in Ipswich and Huddersfield visiting properties bought at auction that are in need of renovation.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Martin Roberts is in Tunbridge Wells to see a one-bedroom flat, and Martel Maxwell visits a former supermarket building in Derbyshire and a terrace in Liverpool.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Martin visits a fairly modern two-bedroom flat in Manchester, the programme revisits a property in Bexleyheath, Kent, that was first seen in 2012, and Dion is in Wolverhampton at a semi-detached house.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: It's a tale of three mid-terraces, with Martin in Burton upon Trent, Martel in Bromley, Kent, and Dion in Merseyside.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: A static caravan is bought for the plot of land it stands on in Dunkirk, Kent. Meanwhile, a semi in Olton in the Midlands and a terrace in South Norwood in London are also sold under the hammer. Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Lucy Alexander meet the new owners to hear plans for their buys.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: It's a family affair as a mother and son develop a house in Knutton in Staffordshire, a father and son work on a one-bedroom flat in London's Cricklewood and a husband-and-wife team take on an ambitious project to make a stonework shop and a brick single-storey former shop one home in Belper in Derbyshire. Martin Roberts and Dion Dublin follow the progress made on their auction buys.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: A couple buy an old prefabricated bungalow in Chesterton in Staffordshire and turn it into their forever dream home, while first-time developers in both Sutton in Surrey and Bilston in the West Midlands hope to sell their projects on for profit. Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell follow progress on their auction property buys.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: A smart one-bedroom flat in Whitefield in Greater Manchester, a large bungalow bought for an unexpected use in Tipton in Derbyshire and a lovely two-bedroom flat in a Victorian building in London's New Cross are sold under the hammer. Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell talk to the property developers who hope to make a profit from their auction buys.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: A trio of terraces are bought by family property-developing teams to try to make some money. Two brothers want to improve the planning permission in place on a terrace in Borough Green in Kent, while a mum and daughter hope they don't have too much to do on their first investment in Liverpool. And a brother and sister who are seasoned property developers have ambitious plans for a generous end-of-terrace in London's Streatham.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: A trio of terraces are sold under the hammer in Carlisle, Forest Gate in London and Walsall in the West Midlands. Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell follow the developers' progress as they all try to make a profit on their auction buys.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: A one-bedroom flat in Peckham in London, a terraced house in Bilston in the West Midlands and a third-floor flat in Maidstone are sold under the hammer. Some take longer than others with the shortest project turned around in days and the longest stretching nearly three years.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Two sets of fathers and sons, and a seasoned property-developing duo buy and renovate properties in Smethwick in the Midlands, Ramsgate in Kent and Chingford in London. Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell follow their progress to see if anyone can make some money on their auction buys.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Martin catches up with an ambitious development in Tredegar in Wales, while Dion chats to a man who wants to turn a house in Great Barr in the Midlands into his family home and Martel is impressed by a grand six-bedroom terrace in Liverpool.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: A two-bedroom flat in Grays in Essex, a stone-built cottage in Lochearnhead in the Highlands of Scotland and a three-bedroom house in Selston in Nottinghamshire are sold under the hammer. Two of the projects run on for several years, but will any of the developers make any money?

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: A period one-bedroom cottage near Blackwell in Worcestershire, a huge Methodist chapel in Dover in Kent and a three-bedroom end-of-terrace in Bootle on Merseyside are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Dion and Martel follow progress as the new owners get underway to make their dreams a reality.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Developers with a pressing deadline of their own race to refurbish a terraced house in Tylorstown in Wales, a businesswoman buys a former takeaway to help her business and a developer got more than he bargains for when he buys a piece of land on the Isle of Sheppey. Martin, Dion and Martel follow progress as the auction buys are developed.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin, Martel Maxwell and Lucy Alexander follow a four-year project to develop land in Maidstone and two swifter developments in Burnley in Lancashire and Meir in Staffordshire. Budgets range from a few thousand to more than a million, but who will turn a profit?

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Three properties sold at action take between a month and six and a half years to complete. But is it the semi in Sittingbourne in Kent, the cottage in Landrake in Cornwall or the flat in London's Maida Vale which will deliver its new owner the biggest profits? Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell follow the refurbishment plans.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: The bank of mum and dad is used to buy a property in Sidcup in Kent, while seasoned developers in Pontygwaith in south Wales and Leeds snap up properties as investments. Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell follow progress on all the work.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: All today's property developments in Plymouth, Treherbert in Wales and Hinckley in Leicestershire take much longer than planned, with projects running a little over a year to eight years to complete. But will any of the developments make their new owners money - Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell follow progress on their ambitious plans.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: The team visit a trio of terraces, with Martin Roberts in Birmingham, Dion Dublin in Bradford and Martel Maxwell going to Dover.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Martin Roberts views a ground-floor flat in London, Martel Maxwell checks out a former commercial unit in Staffordshire, and Dion Dublin is in Birmingham visiting a three-bed semi.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: A one-bedroom ground-floor flat in St Margaret's at Cliffe in Kent, a large terrace house in Dalton-in-Furness in Cumbria and a three-bedroom semi in Great Barr in Birmingham are all sold under the hammer. Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell meet the new owners to hear what they plan for their auction buys.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Martel Maxwell visits a characterful cottage in Saffron Walden, Essex, Dion Dublin checks out a terrace not too far from his old stomping ground in Manchester, and Martin Roberts goes to see a plot of land near Wolverhampton.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Martin Roberts visits a rundown mid-terrace in Dover bought by a plucky first-time developer. Martell Maxwell is in Dudley, West Midlands, viewing an old retail unit, while Dion Dublin is in Manchester looking round a real shell of a building.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Dion Dublin is in Birmingham at a property with one of the smallest kitchens he has come across. Martin Roberts visits a former care home in Penmaenmawr, Wales. Martell Maxwell is in St Helens, Merseyside at a house that seems almost too good to be true.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Two flats in Seaham in Durham, a former bank in Westhoughton near Manchester and a building with a shop and residential space in Surbiton in Surrey are sold under the hammer. The new owners have ambitious plans but soon discover a few twists and turns along the way.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Martin, Dion and Martel follow ambitious property development projects in Brynmawr in Wales, Upchurch in Kent and Stone in Staffordshire. All the projects take longer than planned with one stretching over four years. But who will manage to make a profit from their auction buys?

videos.overview: The team visits properties in Claygate, Willenhall and in Ashton on Ribble.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The team visits properties in Bamford, Lower Gornal and in Gravesend.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The team visits properties in Abercynon, West Bromwich and in Neasden

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The team visits properties in Walthamstow, Dover and in Epping.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The team visits properties in Nuneaton, Wolverhampton and in Stoke-on-Trent.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The team visits properties in Lower Gornal, Gillingham and in Ebbw Vale.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The team visits properties in Plaistow, Plumpton and in Stoke-on-Trent.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A trio of terraces in Norfolk, Mid Glamorgan and Essex are transformed by seasoned developers who battle the rising cost of building materials to turn a profit on their auction buys.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Two quirky Cumbrian properties in Kendal and Heathersgill are sold under the hammer along with a Victorian mid terrace in Luton in Bedfordshire. Martin, Martel and Tommy follow the property renovations and transformations.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Martel is just outside Bradford to see a three-bed end terrace bought by a father-in-law and son-in-law developing duo. Tommy is in Dulwich, visiting a two bedroom garden flat on which a young developer is keen to make his mark. Jacqui is in Sipson, just beside Heathrow Airport, to see a two-bed ground-floor maisonette with a short lease and missing kitchen.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Martin and Dion follow progress on three developments in Chapeltown in Sheffield, Kingsworth in Kent and Kings Heath in Birmingham. All three developers are faced with a long list of challenges, but they all deliver stunning results.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Martin is just outside Tonypandy, South Wales, to see a three-bed mid terrace, bought unseen by a relatively inexperienced developer. He is also in Sheffield, South Yorkshire, to visit a large, derelict, five-bedroom property riddled with dry rot but with great development potential. Jacqui is in Herne Hill, London to see a four-bedroomed, three-storey end of terrace with character and lots of opportunity to add value.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Martel visits Burton-on-Trent in Staffordshire to see a three-bed mid-terrace bought by an ambitious young couple who want to turn it into upmarket studios. Jacqui is in Tunbridge Wells in Kent to look at an interesting lot of garages with the potential for a very lucrative development. Martin is in Grimsby, Lincolnshire, to see a three-bed mid-terrace with a low guide price.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Martin is in Swansea, along with a four-legged friend, to see a three-bed semi-detached house. We revisit a plot of land just outside Bolton in Lancashire that Martel first saw in 2019. Martel is also in Bishop Auckland, County Durham, to see a two-bed terrace with a very low-sounding guide price.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Tommy is in Rugeley in Staffordshire to see a three-bed mid-terrace bought by a trio of experienced developers. Martin is in Cudham in the London borough of Bromley, visiting a two-bed end-terrace bought by a mother to help get her daughter on the property ladder. Jacqui is in north west London to see two flats that may be better reverting back to one.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Jacqui visits Vauxhall in south London to see a three-bed, third-floor flat with a lot of character and potential. She’s also in Aylesbury, Buckinghamshire, to see a mid-terrace property split into two one-bedroom flats. Dion heads to Macclesfield in Cheshire to see a Grade II listed two-bed home in an old mill.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Tommy is in Norwich to see a Grade II listing with bags of charm and potential. Martin is in Folkestone to visit a two-bed maisonette taken on by a builder with an interesting hobby. Dion heads to Wigan to see a three-bed terrace that’s riddled with damp but has great development potential.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Martel is in Beeston, Nottinghamshire, to see a four-bed mid-terrace that the new owners have grand plans to turn into an HMO. Martin is in Welwyn Garden City, Hertfordshire, to see a three-bed end-terrace in need of a new lease of life. Jacqui is in Brighton visiting a rather grand Victorian terrace with five bedrooms over four floors.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: A terrace in Aberdare, a slice of land in Glasgow and an end terrace in Rochester are sold under the hammer. Martin, Dion and Jacqui follow progress on the three developments as their new owners take on very different approaches to their investments.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Martin heads to Cannock in Staffordshire to see a three-bed bungalow with a bizarre layout, taken on by a husband and wife who aren’t afraid to get their hands dirty. He also visits Alsager in Cheshire to see a three-bed semi with lots of space - it’s just in all the wrong places. And Martel is in Hartlepool, County Durham, to visit a two-bed terrace in need of modernisation.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Martel is in Dalry, Ayrshire, to see a ground floor, one-bedroom flat with two front doors. Tommy is in Norwich visiting a former office which comes with plans to turn it into flats. Dion is in Walton, Liverpool, to see two flats that come as part of the same auction lot.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: A Victorian house in Strood in Kent whose only loo was outside, a semi-detached house in Leeds and a damp top floor flat in Kilmarnock are all bought at auction. Three seasoned developers come up against unexpected issues as they work to bring new life into their bricks and mortar.

Jacqui is tackling a three-bedroom semi in Doncaster with damp and an avocado bathroom suite amongst other issues. She’s also on the Essex coast, where a husband-and-wife team have high hopes for an equally high-rise property.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Terraces in Summerstown in London and Darlington are bought at auction by investors, as is a semi-detached house in Crewe. Two of the properties are given wonderful makeovers, while the third is flipped for a profit without any work being done.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: In Dunfermline and Ladywell, two one-bedroom flats in bad states of repair are transformed into smart homes, and a huge former hostel in Torquay is also given an appealing renovation. But will the developers who bought the properties at auction manage to make any profits?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: An end terrace in Manchester, a flat in Liverpool and a semi in Stoke-on-Trent are sold at auction and snapped up by developers hoping to make a profit on their investments. Martin, Dion and Jacqui follow their progress, which varies from a swift 20 days to more than four years.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: A silver-themed house in Sheffield, but it’s not a shining example for Dion. Martin is perplexed by the smallest radiator he’s ever seen in south Wales... or anywhere else for that matter!

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Tommy masks up as he investigates an odour filled townhouse in Windsor. Dion has to do some exploring to find a hidden gem in the form of a three-bed bungalow in Wetherby. And Martel chats to a couple who invest in a holiday flat by the Ayrshire coast in Largs.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Not one but two Surrey cottages are sold together at an online auction, Martin meets friends who develop a two-bedroom flat in Wiltshire for one of them to live in, and Tommy's getting a taste of 'The Good Life' in Surbito.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: A property with beautiful views on the east coast of Scotland, a bundle of properties near Norwich including a barn and a house, and a trio of terraces in Sheffield are sold at auction. Dion, Martel and Tommy meet the developers who hope to make a profit on their investments.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Coastal properties are the flavour of the day with Martin, wowed by the surroundings of a property on the Gower Peninsula, and Jacqui finds herself in a time warp on the east coast of Suffolk. Martel heads inland to see a plot of land in Birmingham.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Two unusual properties in rural Kent and Yorkshire and an impressive large Victorian end terrace in Greater Manchester are sold at auction. Martin, Martel and Tommy talk to the developers and hear their plans to make the most of their property investments.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: A house with a quirky layout in Maidstone, a flat in North Shields and an office in Bognor Regis with planning permission for a flat above it are all sold at online auctions.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Properties in Wakefield in West Yorkshire, Bintree in Norfolk and Folkestone in Kent are bought at auction. Dion, Jacqui and Tommy meet the buyers and follow progress as they work on their development projects.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Tommy visits a two-bed terrace in Stockport, Martin is just outside Stoke-on-Trent, and we return to a mixed lot in Milton in Staffordshire that Dion first visited in early 2021.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: A semi-detached destined to be the buyers' home in Felixstowe, a seven-year project to transform a tired bungalow to help the community in Willenhall and a trendy warehouse apartment in Toxteth are sold under the hammer. Martin, Dion and Tommy check out the projects and meet the developers.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: A terrace in Worksop, a studio apartment in a Bath Georgian crescent and a house with several flats near Liverpool FC's Anfield stadium are all sold under the hammer. Martin and Dion meet the investors hoping to make some money from their buys.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: A characterful, Grade II-listed one-bedroom flat in Bath, a two-bed terrace in Stoke-on-Trent and a pair of terraced houses split into flats go under the hammer.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: A one-bedroom flat in Hackney, a semi in Stoke-on-Trent and a cottage with huge potential in a village just outside Bath are sold at online property auctions. Once renovated, the developers who bought them all hope to turn a profit on their investments.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: It’s a family affair today as two sets of siblings and a father and son team transform auction properties in Leek, Selly Park and Aberfan.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Today's property development projects run from seven weeks to several years. Martin and Dion track progress on renovations in Bristol and Blackley and a building project on land in Stoke.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: A detached house in Whittlesey in Cambridgeshire, a property in Tunstall in Stoke and a terraced house full of period features in Ipswich in Suffolk are all sold at online auctions. Tommy and Jacqui meet the new owners and learn about their plans to make some money from their investments.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Jacqui boards a ferry to view a traditional cottage in Ventnor on the Isle of Wight, while Dion checks out an end terrace in Bradford, as well as following a two-year project in Derby to build eight homes on land formerly used as garages and workshops.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Dion is in Birmingham, while Martin is on a tour in Wales, looking at houses in Treherbert and Swansea. The property developers grapple with rising material costs as they try to add value to their auction investments.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: A fantastic Cornish period house, with several old cars hidden in an overgrown back garden, is sold at an online auction, along with properties in County Durham and south Wales. Martin and Martel tour the houses and meet the owners who plan to give them a new lease of life.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Tommy can see the potential of a piece of land backing onto fields in Hitchin in Hertfordshire, while Jacqui looks around a flat in Penge in south east London. Dion explores a terraced house in Nottingham.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: A terraced house in Birkenhead, a large period property in Ramsgate and a one-bedroom flat in a smart block in Hull are all sold at online auctions. But will any of them turn a profit?

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: A former pub in Stockport, a terraced house in Mansfield Woodhouse and a property housing three self-contained flats in Crewe are all sold under the hammer. All three owners come up against unexpected issues, but will they overcome the challenges and stick to their budgets?

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: It’s a Lancashire double for Dion as he visits two terraced properties, one in Burnley and the other in the town of Padiham. Tommy is in the village of Broadway in Somerset to look at a characterful three-bedroom detached house.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: A young couple buy their first house together in Macclesfield, two brothers buy a set of disused 1950s buildings in Codnor, and another couple renovate a house in Rainworth.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Dion and Martel go to see property developments in Manchester, Sheffield and Hartlepool, including an interesting commercial unit that was previously a photography studio.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: An amazing opportunity by the Kent coast has Martin spying a building opportunity. Dion has an issue staying upright in an uneven mid-terrace in Stoke, and he’s in West Yorkshire to see a charming grade two listed building.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Developers buy two houses in Worksop and Wakefield with plans to rent them out, while in Dewsbury, a midwife and her builder husband buy a house they intend to turn into their forever home.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: A couple of end terraces in Preston and Mid-Glamorgan and a semi-detached in Newcastle are sold under the hammer. Martin and Martel meet the new owners who are ready to tackle the projects with the aim of making a profit on their investments.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Dion, Martel and Tommy follow an impressive project to create four brand new houses in Alcester in Warwickshire, as well as developments to transform terraced houses in Little Hulton in Manchester and Norwich in Norfolk.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Tommy has fun at the seaside, seeing the potential of a rundown terrace house that is being transformed into four smart holiday lets. Dion and Jacqui follow other ambitious projects in Staffordshire and Norfolk.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: It’s a first for Tommy who spots his first sparkly staircase in a semi in Maidstone. He also follows the development of a two-bedroom forever home bungalow in Brightlingsea, and Dion is impressed with the guide price of a smart terrace in Alfreton.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: A developer sees the huge potential of demolition and rebuilding in Crystal Palace. Martel is in Stoke and Tommy is in Bexleyheath talking to a teacher who decided to make his latest buy his family home.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Will properties bought in Sittingbourne, Ferryhill and Poplar turn a profit for their buyers?

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: A long way for Jacqui to travel down a never-ending corridor in Suffolk. Tommy is tackling overgrown plots in both Nottingham and Kent.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Martel meets a woman in Whitehaven, who moves the family just three doors down in Whitehaven to create their forever home, while Dion gets busy counting the numerous cracks in a former office in Coleshill, and an aunt and nephew transform a terrace in Goldborne.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Jacqui falls in love with a smart split-level apartment on the sea front in Southend-on-Sea, while Dion meets two doctor brothers who like to property develop too. Martin is in Ebbw Vale to hear plans to transform a tired mid-terrace.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: A Victorian terrace in Buckinghamshire gets the wow factor with a stunning makeover inside and out, while Jacqui checks out ambitious renovations in Suffolk and Norfolk.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Dion explores ambitious plans and water damage at two properties in Rugby and Doncaster. And a low guide price in the beautiful Rhondda Valley has Martin charmed.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: The elephant in the room is the kitchen in an Essex flat Jacqui takes a look at. Tommy's East Sussex ex-local authority house is destined to become a holiday home. And Martel explores a red sandstone tenement flat in Glasgow bought by a young entrepreneur.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Jacqui is property-hunting in Norfolk. Meanwhile, Martin meets an entrepreneur from Berkshire who is working on a development at the top of the Rhondda Valley in Blaenrhondda.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Jacqui looks at a maisonette in Westcliff-on-Sea, Martin goes to see a flat in need of renovation in Coleford, and Dion is in Barlaston, viewing a three-bedroom end-of-terrace.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Jacqui is in the Medway area of Kent in Upnor to see a two-bedroom terrace with bags of character in a conservation area. Martin is in Bristol to look around a three-bedroom 1930s semi-detached, and Dion is in Birmingham, where a bathroom from a bygone era catches his eye.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Martin visits a three-bedroom semi in Sketty just outside Swansea and a two-bedroom property in Ilfracombe. Tommy is in London on the Isle of Dogs, looking at a three-bedroom flat.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Dion and Jacqui follow the progress on three ambitious projects to bring back to life a pair of semi-detached cottages in Churchtown in Lancashire and two developments in Kent – a tired end terrace in Dover and a purpose-built flat in Margate.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Martel Maxwell views a one-bedroom flat in South Shields with great holiday let potential and a three-bedroom semi in Birmingham. Jacqui Joseph looks at a four-bedroom house in Dover.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Martell Maxwell visits the West Midlands and Darlington to look at a pair of two-bed terraced properties. Meanwhile, Tommy Walsh goes to see a three-bedroom semi in Romford.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Terraces in Durham and Beddau, and a majestic-looking period semi-detached in Crewe are sold at auction. Martin, Dion and Martel meet the new owners and hear how they plan to turn a profit from their bricks-and-mortar investments.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Dion and Martel are criss-crossing the country in Bolsover, Dawley and Darlington, looking at three ambitious property projects ripe for renovation or conversion.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Martin Roberts and Jacqui Joseph meet the buyers at auction of three properties in Bournemouth, Maidstone and Reading. Will the developers make a profit on their projects?

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Martel Maxwell views a two-bedroom mid-terrace in Hartlepool, while Martin Roberts goes to Dudley to look at an end-terrace with a damp issue, and he visits a four-storey townhouse in Newport.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: The properties featured in this episode are a one-bedroom flat in St Leonards with wonderful sea views, a two bedroom mid-terrace in Birkenhead, and a flat in Harrow with a short lease to deal with.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Martin, Dion and Martel check out auction property buys in Plymouth, Silsden in West Yorkshire and the village of Mytholmroyd near Hebden Bridge. The developers do a lot of the work themselves in the hope they can make a profit on their bricks-and-mortar investments.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Terraced houses in Kent and Nottingham, and a flat ripe for a transformation in Derbyshire, are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Dion and Tommy keep an eye on the projects to see how the developers get on, one of whom wants to create a home for herself.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: A flat in Clapham, a terrace in Kent and a bungalow in Stoke-on-Trent are all sold under the hammer. Jacqui, Martin and Dion meet the successful bidders.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Three part-time developers grapple with their new projects: a flat in Faversham, Kent, a former commercial derelict building in Walsall and a terraced house in Leeds.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Grand, stone-built offices converted into a nine-bed family home, two flats that were once a pub and a mid-terrace with a guide price of just £15,000. Martin, Tommy and Martel follow developers in Lancashire, Cheshire and County Durham as they tackle a variety of projects.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: A modest bungalow in rural Cambridgeshire undergoes a £250k transformation, two friends snap up an end-terrace in Cumbria for £35k and a one-bedroom flat gets a high-end makeover in central London, as Jacqui, Martel and Tommy follow the stories of three properties sold at auction.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Land turned into a forever home in Newport, a two-bedroom terrace in surprisingly good condition in Durham, and a three-bedroom house that's seen better days in London. Martin, Martel and Jacqui meet the lucky bidders and follow their renovation journeys.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: A former Victorian miner's cottage in County Durham, which has not been lived in for 20 years, is given a stunning makeover, there are ambitious plans for a former school in Tunbridge Wells, and a Basildon terrace undergoes a smart renovation.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Dion, Martin and Tommy meet the developers working to transform a Victorian town house in Nottingham, a dilapidated mid-terrace in Bournemouth and a one-bedroom flat in north London.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Two brothers beautify a bungalow, an old church is given a dramatic transformation and a 1930s semi becomes a brilliant family home. Dion and Jacqui travel to Suffolk, Staffordshire and Bexley to explore properties bought under the hammer.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: A double dose of Dorset dwellings, and a missing toilet in Cumbria keep Martin and Martel on their toes. Some stunning transformations take place!

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: A smelly Somerset cottage in need of transformation, a Blackpool mid-terrace with sloping floors, and a Leicestershire semi of non-standard construction. Lots for Martin and Dion to get to the bottom of.

videos.title: Celebrity Special 1
videos.overview: A very special 20th birthday episode! Martin is joined by Changing Rooms legend Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen to look around a three-bedroom terrace just outside Bristol.

videos.title: Celebrity Special 2
videos.overview: We’re celebrating 20 years of Homes Under the Hammer with a trip to the capital! Featuring properties in Shepherd's Bush, Chelsea and Manchester.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: A back-to-front house in Eastbourne - what will Tommy make of that? Meanwhile, Dion has to tackle two derelict properties in Grim

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Tommy is by the seaside looking at a great bungalow in Lowestoft, while Martel is also near water in North Shields. Dion looks around a terrace in Bucknall, a suburb of Stoke-on-Trent.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Victorian splendour is how a couple in Whitstable hope to add sparkle to a run-down house just half a mile from the sea. Their passion project will be their home when the project’s finished. There are also ambitious renovations in Bedworth and Torquay.

videos.title: Celebrity Special 3
videos.overview: Dion Dublin is joined by pop superstar and Homes Under the Hammer superfan Toyah Willcox to look around a three-bedroom semi-detached house in Toyah’s native Birmingham.

videos.title: Celebrity Special 4
videos.overview: Jacqui Joseph is joined by broadcaster and drummer Owain Wyn Evans for this special 20th anniversary show. We also go back in time to see one of the show's most iconic properties.

videos.title: Celebrity Special 5
videos.overview: In a special 20th-anniversary episode, Amanda Lovett, one of the stars of BBC hit show The Traitors, joins Tommy Walsh to look around a derelict flat in Buckinghamshire.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Not one, but two houses in London are valued at more than £1 million each after undergoing extensive renovations. Martin, Dion and Tommy check out the projects as well as a development in Huddersfield.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: A scrap of land becomes home to a smart three-bedroom house in Staffordshire, along with transformations in Liverpool and Torquay.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: It's a tale of two bungalows as Martin visits Wolverhampton and Tommy is in Clacton-on-Sea. Martel is also in Glasgow to see a back-to-brick maisonette.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: A three bedroom semi in the West Midlands has Dion worried. Significant cracks are all over the house. And Martin tries to solve a heating mystery in a one-bedroom flat in Dartford.

videos.title: Desirable Dwellings in Lovely Locations
videos.overview: Is it a stairway to heaven? Not quite, it’s a spiral staircase in duplex flat in Southsea, Hampshire that Jacqui’s come to see. Martin is in the sought after town of Cheltenham, and Bishop’s Stortford in Hertfordshire where his colourful shirt makes up for the lack of colour in a two bed flat.

videos.title: Building the Dream
videos.overview: A plot of land in Derby has Dion excited. Tommy is in Suffolk at a project with a challenging plastering job, and Jacqui meets a retired butcher trying his hand at property development.

videos.title: I Hear a Train a Comin'
videos.overview: A house beside a railway has Tommy recommending good double glazing in Orpington, south east London. Dion is in Greater Manchester, where the sandwich bill is racking up for the new owner. In a Lancashire semi, Martel meets a former hairdresser who is undertaking a labour of love.

videos.title: A One-Bedroom Flat Worth One Million Pounds!
videos.overview: Where else but London?! A one-bedroom flat has a potential value of one million pounds if renovated properly. Martel is assessing 25 acres of land in Anglesey. Martin is in Bristol where he disagrees with the new owner about his plans for the layout.

videos.title: Martin Smells Trouble
videos.overview: A house in Hampshire has Martin’s nose out of joint, as an overwhelming odour is making life difficult. Martel is in Aberdeenshire, where a bungalow in a rural setting is a fantastic development opportunity. We revisit a plot of land in Nottingham that Tommy first saw back in early 2022.

videos.title: Ivy Invasion!
videos.overview: Dion tackles overgrown ivy that is invading an end-of-terrace house in north Wales. He also deals with damp in a Stoke bungalow. Martel is in Nottinghamshire, where former retail premises are not currently fit for purpose.

videos.title: A Riverside Grade Two Listed Cottage
videos.overview: A riverside period house alongside a riverside path in historic Canterbury is modernised for a family, and a grandfather transforms a flat in Brighton to be nearer to his grandchildren. Work also gets under way to transform a house in need of TLC in Ashton-under-Lyne.

videos.title: Three Houses for the Price of One
videos.overview: A father-and-daughter development team buy a bungalow with a view in Eastbourne and knock it down to build three detached houses, a husband and wife renovate a terraced house in Chesterton, and two electricians transform a house in Solihull.

videos.title: Big Dipper in Stoke
videos.overview: Dion is navigating some severely uneven flooring at an end-of-terrace house in Stoke. Jacqui has layout changes in mind at a flat in east London. A three-bedroom terrace in Kent has Tommy on the hunt for an upstairs toilet.

videos.title: Million-Pound-Plus Property
videos.overview: Martin falls in love with a large London house with a million-pound-plus guide price. Dion is on familiar ground at a two-bedroom mid-terrace in Stoke. And Jacqui sees great potential to extend at a rural Surrey property.

videos.title: Too Good to Be True?
videos.overview: Dion struggles to find fault with a mid-terrace in Stoke, but could there be any hidden nasties? Another terrace in Staffordshire requires more attention! And a flat in south east London has Jacqui fretting over the short lease.

videos.title: Norfolk Showstopper
videos.overview: Tommy sees the potential in a bungalow in the beautiful Norfolk Broads, while Dion is on familiar turf in both Stoke and Coventry with two intriguing projects.

videos.title: Pampered Pooches
videos.overview: A former care centre in Waterlooville is converted into a smart family home for a young couple, their baby daughter, ten pet dogs and their dog grooming business.

videos.title: A Tale of Three Semis
videos.overview: It’s a semi-detached extravaganza in this episode, with Dion visiting properties in Stoke and on the Wirral, while Tommy is in Gillingham, Kent.

videos.title: Nice to See You Again!
videos.overview: We welcome back two developers who’ve been on the show before. One is tackling a big end-of-terrace in north London, whereas the other seems to have nabbed a bargain in Suffolk. Martel also checks out an interesting property in Morecambe with beautiful sea views.

videos.title: A Family Affair
videos.overview: All three property renovations today are led by family partnerships – a husband, wife and daughter team in Madeley, brothers-in-law in Castleton and an entire family in Newton Aycliffe get stuck in. All three renovations throw up unexpected issues, but will family harmony remain intact?

videos.title: What a Marathon
videos.overview: A marathon runner completes a marathon seven-year project to transform a site in Llanfynydd into smart holiday accommodation, while a couple give a terraced house in Derby the real wow factor and friends in Southend-on-Sea create a lovely coastal home for someone.

videos.title: Five for the Price of One
videos.overview: A couple create five high-end homes from a former care home close to the sea in Seaford, Tommy along with developers in Hucknall sees the potential of two rundown terraces, and a former estate agent sees things from the other side with a development project in Shildon.

videos.title: Family and Friends
videos.overview: Martin Roberts and Martel Maxwell meet developers working alongside partners or friends to transform dated and unloved properties. They follow their progress on two houses in Leeds, while a third development in Fenton in Staffordshire delivers a twist.

videos.title: Flat-tastic
videos.overview: A trio of rundown flats in Glasgow, London and Bournemouth are given the wow factor by family-developing teams who know how to turn unloved properties into desirable homes.

videos.title: Mistaken Identity
videos.overview: Martel meets two friends in Hull who seem to have bought the wrong property. Tommy is in Suffolk, where a patch-up job isn’t hiding the damp in an end-of-terrace. And Dion meets two brothers in Liverpool who seem to have it all under control.

videos.title: Will Looks Be Deceiving?
videos.overview: Martin’s in Wales, where a mixed commercial and residential unit is in surprisingly good condition. Jacqui’s house in Norwich is in similarly decent nick. But are they hiding any secret issues? Dion is in Staffordshire where a three bedroom mid-terrace has a quirky layout to contend with.

videos.title: Love Is in the Air
videos.overview: Martin falls in love with a period sandstone cottage in Shropshire, and the owner cements his love for his girlfriend at the end of the renovation by proposing!

videos.title: Can You Dig It?
videos.overview: A developer in Plymouth has tunnel vision with his plans to dig down at a bungalow, Martin is cracking up at a semi-detached house in Staffordshire, and in Suffolk, Jacqui sees the potential in a detached property.

videos.title: Last Orders in Cambridgeshire
videos.overview: A former pub has Martel feeling sentimental about her younger days as a barmaid. Martin is being attacked by unruly foliage in Devon, and he goes to see a house with a suspiciously low guide price in the West Midlands.

videos.title: From Worst to Best
videos.overview: Two brothers work on a very tired boarded-up house in Widnes and turn it into the best-looking house on the street. Meanwhile, a couple also add value to an auction buy in Folkestone, and a developer in Dalry stands to double his money after rejigging the layout of a detached house.

videos.title: It's a Jungle out There
videos.overview: A jungle in the front and back of a terrace in Southampton is tamed with a smart interior to match, while developers crack on with transforming a detached house in Dudley and building a row of terraces in Chesterton.

videos.title: Smallest House Ever?
videos.overview: Is a house in Wales the smallest Martin has ever encountered in his 20 years on the show? Meanwhile, Dion is captivated by a rather funky, retro carpet in a terrace in Lancashire. And Tommy’s in Wandsworth, London, where a one-bedroom garden flat has potential to add space.

videos.title: A Musical Sink
videos.overview: Dion creates a great drum beat on an old kitchen sink in Stoke before the terrace is transformed into a stunning home and there are equally ambitious plans for a period flat in Stirling and a car park in Leeds.

videos.title: Horsing Around
videos.overview: Martel tries to remain stable, despite there being no horses, as she looks around a Cumbrian house set on three acres of land.

videos.title: Back-to-Front House in South Yorkshire
videos.overview: Never mind about stairs up to the bedrooms, where’s the front door? Dion has to figure it out in a three-bedroom mid-terrace in South Yorkshire.

videos.title: Digging It
videos.overview: Jacqui is impressed that a first-floor Aldershot flat comes with its own back garden, Dion can see the-money making potential in a large house in Wallasey, and a woman swaps hairdressing for house development in Great Yarmouth.

videos.title: Bolthole
videos.overview: The new owner of a terrace in Crewe isn’t put off by the numerous safety bolts on the front door. The seasoned developer turns it into a smart HMO (house in multiple occupation).

videos.title: What’s Behind the Trapdoor?
videos.overview: A 300-year-old property in Kent with a mysterious trapdoor has Tommy intrigued. He’s also in Norfolk, where we revisit a derelict mid-terrace property. Jacqui is braving the wet weather in Cambridgeshire.

videos.title: Read all about it!
videos.overview: Martel discovers old newspapers dating a two-bed mid terrace in south Wales, but they don’t tell the whole story of a property that needs completely salvaging.

videos.title: Two-Million-Pound Project
videos.overview: Dion Dublin follows progress on a project to create student accommodation in Liverpool, which could net the developers a cool two- million-pound profit, while developers in Snodland and Normanton face challenges bringing unloved homes back to life.

videos.title: Blank Canvas
videos.overview: A Southport Victorian villa provides a blank canvas for a six-figure development project, while in South Shields there's a much smaller budget for an already pristine maisonette. In Folkestone, a father and daughter set to work creating a smart HMO.

videos.title: Two for the Price of One
videos.overview: Two brothers buy a pair of cottages in north Norfolk and plan to create one stunning family home.

videos.title: Back to School for Martin
videos.overview: There are lessons to be learned at a former primary school in Tunbridge Wells for Martin. He’s also flummoxed by the layout of an end-of-terrace in Somerset. Jacqui has a lot of stairs to climb in Kent.

videos.title: Where’s the Catch?
videos.overview: A one-bedroom flat in Somerset has Martin struggling to find jobs that need doing, as it’s in great condition. Dion’s in Wigan, where the cracks are showing in a two-bedroom mid-terrace, while a Grade II listed cottage in Kent charms Tommy.

videos.title: Leaps of Faith
videos.overview: Characterful cottages in both south Wales and Norfolk are bought by people who didn’t originally intend to bid on them! A Staffordshire building plot just keeps on giving and giving!

videos.title: Cracking Up
videos.overview: A major crack in a two-bedroom cottage in New Malden doesn’t stop a fashion student from buying it or from giving the finished project the wow factor.

videos.title: Multimillion-Pound Mansion
videos.overview: A stunning multimillion-pound project in London that Tommy first saw in 2021 reaches an epic conclusion. Martel encounters two characterful projects in North Yorkshire and Cumbria.

videos.title: The Wow Factor
videos.overview: Dion looks at a down-at-heel 1930s Nottingham bungalow that's been transformed into a modern, stylish house, while developers in Workington and Gillingham also work wonders on their auction buys.

videos.title: Mind Your Head, Tommy
videos.overview: Tommy has to duck to fit into a Norfolk cottage with a very low ceiling height. Martel searches for the toilet in a mid-terrace in South Yorkshire, and Dion tries to stay warm, just outside Stoke.

videos.title: What a Stunner
videos.overview: A young couple buy their first home together in Haydock and transform the three-bedroom semi-detached house into a stunning place for them to live.

videos.title: Divine Inspiration
videos.overview: A former chapel in rural Hethersgill in Cumbria is converted into a glorious holiday home, while developers in Southall and South Norwood create lovely homes from worn-out property auction buys.

videos.title: Call the Cops
videos.overview: A flashback to 2016, when Dion visited a former police station in Birmingham that wasn’t your usual auction lot. Things are a bit more conventional for him in Liverpool at a three-bedroom mid-terrace, but there’s nothing 'standard' about Jacqui’s property in Hertfordshire.

videos.title: Colour Clash!
videos.overview: A purple interior clashes with Jacqui’s outfit in Norfolk, Owain’s admiring the view in Swansea, and Dion can’t believe how good things are at his end-terrace in Liverpool.

videos.title: Who Needs Walls Anyway?
videos.overview: The walls threaten to come tumbling down for Martin at a mid-terrace in south Wales, a Grade II listed former church in Cambridgeshire has Tommy excited about its potential, and Dion is loving the character in a Lincolnshire cottage.

videos.title: Mum Knows Best!
videos.overview: A young developer follows his mother's advice in Bushey Heath and is surprised to hear the potential profit if he ever sells on the ground floor flat.

videos.title: Tommy's Too Tall
videos.overview: Tommy is struggling for headroom at an Essex mid-terrace, while in south London, Jacqui has to watch her step at a ground floor flat. Owain is in south Wales, where he’s excited by the potential on offer.

videos.title: A Trio of Terraces
videos.overview: Dion and Martel are in Cheshire, Yorkshire and the Midlands, looking at terraces. They all have three things in common - low auction guide prices, lots of work to be done and smart new looks once everything is finished.

videos.title: Owain Blending in with the Furniture? Surely Not!
videos.overview: Owain’s outfit matches perfectly with the décor at a Wolverhampton semi. A Cumbrian barn conversion gives Martel serious holiday vibes. And Martin creates an imaginary canine companion in Nottingham.

videos.title: We're Living the High Life
videos.overview: Tommy’s head is in the clouds with the stunning city views from a London high rise. His luck continues with a trip to the beautiful Norfolk coast. Martel is on home soil at a Perthshire maisonette.

videos.title: A Tiger on the Loose!
videos.overview: A tiger in a north London maisonette has Owain earning his stripes. Don’t panic, it’s not a real one! Dion is dealing with damp in Kidsgrove, and Martel is in Hartlepool, where a two-bedroom mid-terrace has an intriguingly low guide price.

videos.title: Top Town House
videos.overview: A Sheffield town house is given an incredible makeover, with a wow factor in every room, while developers also transform tired properties in Newcastle-under-Lyme and Kirkaldy.

videos.title: Flat Out!
videos.overview: Martel, Jacqui and Owain are across the UK, checking out no less than four flats in Scotland, England and Wales! All are in a poor state of repair, and all are transformed, adding new kitchens, bathrooms and extra bedrooms in the hope of adding profit too.

videos.title: A Sinking Feeing
videos.overview: Jacqui gets that sinking feeling as she tours a Norwich house suffering from subsidence, while Martin is really surprised by developers' plans to rip everything out of a six-bedroom house in Cardiff.

videos.title: Stunning Coastal Retreat
videos.overview: A Victorian cottage by the water's edge in Plymouth is given a breathtaking new look, worthy of the views from its windows, while developers also work hard in Stoke and Pembroke Dock to add value to their projects.

videos.title: Lopsided Layouts
videos.overview: The layouts aren’t working for anyone today! Martin is confused in Cornwall, Owain is baffled in Birmingham, and Tommy is gobsmacked in Gillingham.

videos.title: Back to the Future for Dion
videos.overview: A Coventry mid-terrace has Dion having flashbacks to his childhood, a former fish-and-chip shop in Cumbria has Martel feeling peckish, and there’s a bad smell in the air for Martin in the Welsh valleys.

videos.title: Love Nest by the Lake
videos.overview: A scenic plot of land in Staffordshire by the water has Dion beaming with enthusiasm, while Jacqui is trying to crack the code of a safe left behind in a house in Norfolk. Great minds think alike as Martin and the new owner of a house in south Wales have the same ideas on how to improve the layout.

videos.title: Old News to New News!
videos.overview: Dion gets all nostalgic at a former newsagent's in Greater Manchester, while Jacqui’s in pole position in Norfolk at a bungalow bought by a young Formula One engineer. In Buckinghamshire, Martin fails to smell a rat in a first-floor maisonette.

videos.title: Cosmetic Surgery in London Flat
videos.overview: Jacqui meets a cosmetic surgeon and his partner in south London, keen to transform a one-bedroom flat into a stylish home. She’s also in Dover, where the damp is penetrating in a mid-terrace. Martin is in Plymouth, where he’s pleasantly surprised by the condition of a semi-detached house.

videos.title: A Perfect Fit
videos.overview: A kitchen and bathroom fitter finds the perfect renovation in the historic town of Wem - an apartment in need of a new kitchen and bathroom - while two families in Gillingham and Hartlepool get to work transforming tired terraces.

videos.title: Rooms with Views
videos.overview: A father and daughter duo build three stunning townhouses in Eastbourne boasting lovely views, while developers in Bilston and Croydon transform an existing terrace and flat into smart modern homes.

videos.title: Always Read the Small Print
videos.overview: A father and son benefit from being eagle-eyed with a last-minute change to the legal pack in Somerset. Owain likes the flexibility on offer at an end-of-terrace in Oxfordshire. Jacqui meets an old friend of the show in Suffolk.

videos.title: Homes Under the Hammer Down Under
videos.overview: A couple buy a house in Wales while on the way to the airport for a holiday in Australia and complete the sale while they are still down under. Two other developers stick closer to home and transform houses in need of some TLC in Dudley and Stoke-on-Trent.

videos.title: Bedroom Wars!
videos.overview: Two brothers argue over who’ll be getting the biggest bedroom in Stoke. Some textured walls in Cannock have Dion raising his eyebrows, while Martel is on home turf in Scotland, where dad is taking the lead from his youngest daughter!

videos.title: Adding and Subtracting
videos.overview: Developers in Eye in Cambridgeshire and Hylton Castle near Sunderland rejig layouts in their two-bedroom houses to each create an additional bedroom.

videos.title: A Marriage of Old and New
videos.overview: A developer in Plymouth transforms a tired 1930s semi-detached house into a smart modern home while keeping some of its period features, and projects in Newport and Ilford also transform tired-looking homes in order to welcome new tenants.

videos.title: For Whom the Bell Tolls
videos.overview: In Glasgow, a characterful doorbell has Martel amused. Martin struggles with layout issues in east London. Dion is in Derby hoping to get three wishes from a genie in the lamp!

videos.title: A Hole Made Whole Again
videos.overview: Jacqui is stopped in her tracks by a huge hole in the floor of a former restaurant in Westcott in Surrey, while Martin is impressed with developers' plans for their buys in Glastonbury and south London.

videos.title: Try Before You Buy!
videos.overview: In Bournemouth, Martin warns the buyer to beware, as a huge crack in a three-bedroom house requires urgent attention. In Kent, Jacqui is relieved that it’s a brickie who has taken on a challenging renovation. Dion meets some old friends of the show in the West Midlands.

videos.title: Multi-Generational Living
videos.overview: Grandma, mum and dad are weighing up whether to move into an Orpington bungalow, which has been totally transformed by a younger member of their family, while developers in Birkenhead and Ilkeston both manage to create additional bedrooms in their properties by rejigging existing layouts.

videos.title: Brotherly Love
videos.overview: It's a labour of love for two brothers, who create a wonderful home for their sister in Chesterton, while Martin is puzzled by a door leading nowhere in Plymouth and Dion follows a speedy flat renovation in Wales.

videos.title: Hold the Phone, Dion!
videos.overview: Dion is charmed by a 19th-century cottage just outside Birmingham, and in particular the old-fashioned phone left behind. There’s plenty of room for Tommy to park at a row of garages in London, and Jacqui is in Ipswich where a tiny shower just off the kitchen can’t be passed off as being quirky!

videos.title: Rule Breakers!
videos.overview: Martin meets a big fan of the show in Hampshire but is disappointed to hear he’s ignored the Hammer golden rules of buying at auction. In Kent, we see the conclusion of a period restoration that Jacqui first saw in early 2023. Dion’s taking in the scenery in beautiful north Wales.

videos.title: Martin's Feeling Blue
videos.overview: The blue walls in an end-of-terrace in east London have Martin searching for a paintbrush. It’s a different story for him in Hampshire, where a two-bedroom cottage oozes character. A former post office in Cumbria delivers lots to think about for Dion.

videos.title: Celebrity Special with Martin and Scarlett Moffatt
videos.overview: Turn the Gogglebox on and tune in to see Martin and special celebrity guest presenter Scarlett Moffatt take a tour of a Sunderland property that has them looking to break out the champagne.

videos.title: Celebrity Special with Dion and Steel from Gladiators
videos.overview: Dion brings some muscle to Newcastle-under-Lyme in the form of Steel from Gladiators, who helps him to wrestle an end-of-terrace into shape.

videos.title: Celebrity Special with Owain and Ian 'H' Watkins
videos.overview: Owain shows friend and pop sensation Ian 'H' Watkins around a Step-tacular, tiny home in the historic town of Stratford-upon-Avon.

videos.title: Celebrity Special with Jacqui and Sarah Greene
videos.overview: Broadcasting icon Sarah Greene teams up with Jacqui to explore a three-bedroom terrace in Northampton, where the work is already underway.

videos.title: Celebrity Special with Martel and James Bye
videos.overview: James Bye swaps Albert Square for a Leicestershire property snoop with Martel, who auditions for a role in EastEnders while James gets stuck into the stripping-out.

videos.title: Too Good to Be True?
videos.overview: A Newcastle house in seemingly great condition but with a suspiciously low guide price has Martel wondering what the catch is. videos.title: £10,000 Flat... What a Deal!
videos.overview: Is a £10,000 guide price on a flat in Ayrshire too good to be true? Martin sees the light in a South London property. And Tommy’s blown away by the views at an East Sussex house.

videos.title: A Real Barnstormer
videos.overview: The prospect of a stunning barn conversion in West Sussex has Martin excited. In east London, Jacqui can’t find enough plug sockets. And Dion’s in Cheshire, where a first-time developer hasn’t followed the 'Hammer Golden Rules'.

videos.title: Bringing the Outside In
videos.overview: Dion’s in Derbyshire to meet a couple determined to connect a characterful cottage with a beautiful garden to create their dream home.

videos.title: Listen to Dad!
videos.overview: A father is disappointed in his son, who failed to visit the property or read the legal pack at a Liverpool terrace. Will he live to regret it? Tommy and Jacqui are in London, where both of them happen to be visiting two-bedroom flats!

videos.title: Triple Wow
videos.overview: Martel is blown away by the grandeur of a 19th-century home in South Shields ripe for renovation, while developers in Newcastle under Lyme and Sheffield deliver the wow factor with stunning renovations.

videos.title: Worth the Wait!
videos.overview: We see the culmination of a five year project in Cheshire, but will a couple be able to create their dream home? videos.title: Anyone for Tennis?
videos.overview: Martin is served up a treat at a Wimbledon flat, Martel likes the character at a Sunderland property, and Dion descends on Doncaster, where he dishes out a yellow card to a developer who hasn’t viewed his new auction purchase.

videos.title: Laying Out the Changes
videos.overview: Significant layout changes are in store for three properties in Merseyside, London and Rotherham. Will the new owners manage to transform their auction purchases on budget?

videos.title: Cupboard with a View!

videos.title: It's Not Rocket Science
videos.overview: An aerospace engineer applies his design skills to property development in Derby, but are his skills complementary? Jacqui visits properties in Croydon and Great Yarmouth, where the new purchasers are hands on.

videos.title: Open Goal!
videos.overview: Dion meets a football fan in Liverpool, keen to tailor his new property for visitors to Anfield. In South Shields, Martel is tip-toeing around the drips from the leaking roof. Jacqui is riding high in a tower block in Essex.

videos.title: Million-Pound-Plus Brixton Building!
videos.overview: In Brixton in south London, Martel meets a builder intent on transforming a period terrace into a beautiful family home, but it won’t come cheap!

videos.overview: A trio of no-nonsense developers tackle property projects in east London, Kent and Nottingham. There are some significant hurdles to overcome. Can they achieve their goals?

videos.overview:
In south Wales, Owain Wyn Evans is impressed by a social enterprise helping to teach the local community practical property renovation skills.

Jacqui Joseph takes in the sea views at a flat in Margate, and Martin Roberts has to navigate his way through a jungle of a garden in Leicestershire.

videos.title: Mum to the Rescue!
videos.overview: In Essex, a mother helps her daughter get onto the property ladder. Jacqui is impressed with a huge house in south London, and Martin takes in the scenery in the Welsh valleys.

videos.title: When Two Become One!
videos.overview: We return to Norfolk to see if two brothers can finish transforming a pair of old farm cottages into one luxury home. Dion meets a developer in Northampton who has grand plans of his own, and in Kingston upon Thames, Jacqui likes the plans a new owner has for a one-bedroom flat.

videos.title: Friends Reunited!
videos.overview: Three sets of developers who have all appeared on the show before tackle a variety of projects in Shropshire, County Durham and Staffordshire. Will their experience shine through, or are they destined to repeat mistakes of the past?

videos.title: Pretty in Pink

videos.title: Bungalow Bonanza!
videos.overview: Two bungalows in Derbyshire and Norfolk offer up lots of potential. Dion is impressed by the space on offer in a Liverpool mid-terrace.

videos.title: Good Things Come to Those Who Wait!
videos.overview: We see the completion of a six-year project in Wales! Jacqui is extolling the virtues of original features in south London and Buckinghamshire.

videos.title: Far from Run of the Mill

videos.title: Read All about It!
videos.overview: Some 1960s newspapers are uncovered by Martin in Hampshire, Martel is impressed with what’s on offer in Yorkshire, and Tommy feels at home in east London.

videos.title: Super City Getaway Pad

videos.title: Patience is a Virtue
videos.overview: Timescales are out the window at three projects in Kent, Yorkshire and London, but will it be worth the wait?

videos.title: Not for the Faint-Hearted!

videos.title: Homecoming for Dion

videos.title: Mould... Always Believe in Your Soul!

videos.title: Love Nest by the Lake

videos.overview: Three sets of developers seek to squeeze every bit of space out of properties in Northampton, Leeds and Coventry.

videos.overview: A driving instructor and his wife are determined to transform a Derby bungalow, Jacqui wants to solve the mystery of a house in Corby, and in north Wales, Dion seeks enlightenment.

videos.title: Teach Us the Way
videos.overview: A retired school teacher in Wales has a few lessons for Martin, and he meets a father and daughter in the West Midlands. Jacqui has the emergency services on hand at a property in Kent.

videos.title: Well Worth the Wait in Cornwall
videos.overview: An old Sunday School in Cornwall undergoes a heavenly transformation. Two other unique properties in Hampshire and Lancashire are up for auction with interesting plans afoot.

videos.overview: Have an animal-loving couple done enough research at a plot of land in Leicestershire? Quirky properties in North Yorkshire and Norfolk also go under the hammer, with intriguing results!

videos.overview: Three intriguing auction lots! A beachside hideaway in Bognor Regis, a characterful granite building in Aberdeen and a two-bedroom property which could magically become a four-bedroom terrace in Lancashire.

videos.overview: Two fascinating Welsh auction lots and a Kent house with not one but two front doors. Will it be twice as much work or double the profit?

videos.overview: Two couples tackle their debut renovations in Nottinghamshire and south London. An altogether more experienced hand takes on a big project in Lancashire.

videos.overview: Martin doesn’t know which way’s up or which way’s down at a holiday let in Cornwall. Dion and Martel love what’s on offer at their properties in the West Midlands and Tyne and Wear.

videos.title: Use Your Senses!
videos.overview: All of Martin’s senses are set tingling at a London flat. Dion is banging the drum for a semi-detached property in Crewe. And Martel sees the possibilities at an end-of-terrace in County Durham.

videos.title: Shaking Things Up!
videos.overview: Martin meets a former cocktail bar worker, who is now mixing it up in the property world. Owain is in Herefordshire, where there’s a lot of work to be done at a town house. And Martel likes the choices on offer at a commercial premises in Ayrshire.

videos.title: Patience Is Rewarded
videos.overview: Two long-term London projects take time to come to fruition, but good things come to those who wait. A County Durham house is in line for an extension.

videos.title: Dion's Seeing Double!!
videos.overview: It’s double Dion in Nottinghamshire as he magically recreates himself, but can he find the key to get outside? Martel is on an energy efficiency drive in Newcastle. Jacqui’s in a trendy part of London.

videos.title: Family Ties!
videos.overview: It’s an emotional reunion for the new owner of a Staffordshire house with a strong family connection. Martel is by the seaside on the west coast of Scotland. And Jacqui explores opportunities in leafy Hertfordshire. All three projects are being tackled by novice developers, but how will they get on?

videos.title: Emergency Rescue!
videos.overview: A firefighter is on hand to try to save a Somerset terrace. Owain is taken by the period features in a Worcestershire house. And we catch up with a plot of land in Staffordshire first seen in 2022.

videos.title: Too Mushroom on the Ceiling!
videos.overview: Jacqui is not impressed by the mushrooms growing inside a Norfolk end-of-terrace. In the West Midlands, Dion thinks some walls need to be rebuilt. Martel loves the story behind how a foster father and his son paired up as property developers.

videos.title: Space Creators!
videos.overview: Three property renovators attempt to create extra space at properties in Shropshire, London and Yorkshire. Can they achieve their objectives?

videos.overview: Martin encounters a layout he’s never seen before, which is rare given his 20-plus years on the show! Dion encounters all weathers in Manchester and Leeds.

videos.title: A Colourful Collection
videos.overview: Martel is struck by the fetching colour of a County Durham house. Dion is impressed by what’s on offer in Greater Manchester and Derbyshire.

videos.title: A Bangor Bonanza!
videos.overview: Dion has to navigate his way through an eight bedroom behemoth in Bangor. Jacqui takes in the views in Dover. And Tommy is in Lincolnshire to look around a bungalow.

videos.title: Southampton Mould Museum
videos.overview: Martin is overcome by the mould at a Southampton semi. Owain loves the 70s period charm on offer in Herefordshire. And Jacqui is in upmarket Chelsea, but the flat she’s in is not as fashionable as the area... at least for now!

videos.title: Two Men and Their Dogs
videos.overview: Two dog-loving developers tackle epic projects in Wales and Norfolk. Also, a seasoned developer is looking to move quickly and economically in Nottingham.

videos.title: Banish the Beige!
videos.overview: Martin is overcome by the amount of beige on show in a Telford flat. Dion heads downwards to reveal an unexpected bonus in Leeds. In Suffolk, there are character features for Jacqui to uncover.

videos.title: Celebrity Special with Martel and Nitro from Gladiators
videos.overview: Martel and Nitro are duelling with each other over ideas at a studio flat in London. Martin is also in Somerset, where another character property is ripe for reinvention.

videos.title: Celebrity Special with Jacqui and Frankie from The Traitors
videos.overview: Jacqui has recruited Frankie from The Traitors, but will she be faithful to an auction property in Kent? videos.title: Celebrity Special with Martin and Carol Smillie
videos.overview: Carol Smillie is in for a shock when she sees the state of the property Martin shows her around in Scotland. We time-travel back to 2006 when Martin saw a house in a stunning location in Wiltshire. Jacqui is in Warwickshire where outside space is at a premium.

videos.title: Celebrity Special with Dion and Duncan James from Blue
videos.overview: Dion and Duncan disagree over what needs to be done at a Notting Hill flat. We trawl the archives and travel back to when a fresh-faced Dion looked around a Leicestershire cottage, more than ten years ago. Jacqui is in Norwich where there's an added bonus at her property.

videos.title: Double Down for Dion
videos.overview: Dion’s in Sheffield, where he feels there is scope to double the size of a property. He is also in Nottingham with layout changes on the menu. Jacqui offers a 16th-century history lesson in Windsor.

videos.title: Property Fitness Programme!
videos.overview: Martin meets someone in Devon who is trading his gym membership for the manual labour of property development! Jacqui is in Norfolk off the beaten path... well sort of. Dion's been put behind bars in Birkenhead.

videos.title: Wonky Work in Wiltshire!
videos.overview: Martin encounters a Grade II listed property in Wiltshire with a dodgy-looking extension that the new owner will surely have to rectify. videos.title: Don't Panic, Captain Roberts!

videos.title: A Real Barnstormer!

videos.title: Liability Layouts!
videos.overview: Properties in Yorkshire, Lancashire and Suffolk all present their own particular layout challenges.

videos.overview: Jacqui is in Charles Dickens country in Kent, but will it be a 'Bleak House'? Martin visits south Wales to see a terrace that has a complicated outdoor layout. And Dion travels to Cheshire, where a bungalow takes his fancy.

videos.title: Living in a Box!

videos.title: Recreate the Space
videos.overview: Layout changes galore at properties in Plymouth, Rochdale and Bradford, but can the new owners of these three auction properties make the best use of the space available to them.

videos.title: Stunningly Styled
